top_news.title: Iran proposes a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz in 7 days if the US meets its conditions
top_news.summary: Iran has offered to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and resume talks on its nuclear program in seven days if the United States lifts its naval blockade, waives sanctions on Iranian oil sales and observes a ceasefire that would include Lebanon. Iran’s foreign minister detailed the proposal to reporters outside the U.N. Security Council on Friday. The deal mirrors the so-called Memorandum of Understanding reached in June, but with an accelerated timetable and would also set a start date for the resumption of nuclear talks with the United States. The earlier agreement quickly collapsed as Iran resumed attacks on shipping in the strait.

Muslim American leaders are defending Sharia, comparing it to other religious codes like the Ten Commandments and Jewish law. Sabeel Ahmed, director of an outreach group called GainPeace, travels the U.S. to educate people about Sharia, emphasizing its guidance for living with faith and justice. He and his allies argue that anti-Sharia rhetoric by GOP politicians is a form of fearmongering.

articles.title: Iran proposes a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz in 7 days if the US meets its conditions
articles.summary: Iran has offered to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and resume talks on its nuclear program in seven days if the United States lifts its naval blockade, waives sanctions on Iranian oil sales and observes a ceasefire that would include Lebanon. Iran’s foreign minister detailed the proposal to reporters outside the U.N. Security Council on Friday. The deal mirrors the so-called Memorandum of Understanding reached in June, but with an accelerated timetable and would also set a start date for the resumption of nuclear talks with the United States. The earlier agreement quickly collapsed as Iran resumed attacks on shipping in the strait.
